Job Title: Project Engineer Substations Engineering

Location: Chennai
Experience: 11 to 20Years
Qualification: B.E./B. Tech Electrical Engineering
Industry: Power / Electrical / Substation Engineering


Job Summary:


We are looking for an experienced Project Engineer Substations Engineering to handle secondary engineering and protection & control design activities for AIS/GIS substations. The role involves substation design, technical documentation, vendor coordination, customer interaction, tender/project engineering and support during erection and commissioning.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Review tender documents, technical specifications and prepare design intent documents.
  • Prepare Protection SLDs, schematics, circuit diagrams, wiring/termination diagrams and cable schedules.
  • Develop signal lists, trip matrices, logics, interlocks and relay ordering information.
  • Design and review Control & Relay panels, auxiliary AC/DC systems and substation interfaces.
  • Perform CT/VT sizing, voltage-drop calculations, cable sizing and related engineering studies.
  • Review and technically evaluate vendor drawings, offers and equipment documentation.
  • Coordinate with engineering, project, SCM, vendors, customers and other design teams.
  • Support FAT/SAT, customer approvals, site visits, erection and commissioning activities.
  • Handle SCADA/RTU, Bay Controller, Teleprotection and primary equipment interfaces.
  • Prepare BoQ, engineering effort estimates and support tender costing.
  • Identify technical risks/opportunities and ensure timely completion of engineering deliverables.
  • Ensure compliance with IEC/IEEE standards, quality requirements and safety-by-design principles.
  • Contribute to OPEX, process improvement and initiatives to reduce engineering effort.


Required Skills:


  • Strong experience in Substation Secondary Engineering and Protection & Control.
  • Hands-on experience in AIS/GIS substation design.
  • Expertise in Protection SLD, schematics, control & relay panels and cable engineering.
  • Knowledge of CT/VT sizing, AC/DC auxiliary systems and relay engineering.
  • Knowledge of SCADA/RTU, Bay Controller and Teleprotection interfaces.
  • Experience in vendor drawing review, technical offer evaluation and customer approvals.
  • Proficiency in CAD tools and E3.
  • Good knowledge of IEC/IEEE standards.
  • Strong project coordination, communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and guide/coordinate engineering activities across teams and countries.

Preferred Profile:


Candidates with 11–15 years of relevant experience in Substation Engineering / Protection & Control / Secondary Engineering, preferably with experience in both tendering and project execution, will be preferred.

Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company that is simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system.

Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, Limerick in Ireland and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity

JOB POSITION

JOB RESPONSIBILITY

  • Develop and maintain microservice architecture and API management solutions using REST and gRPC for seamless deployment of AI solutions.
  • Design and implement AI pipelines using both predictive modelling and agentic framework.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists and product managers, to acquire, process, and manage data for AI/ML model integration and optimization.

  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders to develop innovative and effective natural language processing solutions, specializing in text classification, sentiment analysis, and topic modeling.
  • Design and execute rigorous A/B tests for machine learning models, analyzing results to drive strategic improvements and decisions.

  • Contribute to creating specialized AI solutions in healthcare, leveraging domain-specific knowledge for task adaptation and deployment.

Specialized training, certifications, and/or other special requirements: Nice to have

Technical Skills:

  • Ability to understand availability metrics like 99.99% and architect systems that satisfy the required availability.

  • Able to work on RFP (Request for Proposals) and RFI (Request for Information).
  • Capability to define and create various architectures including technical, deployment, security, and functional overview. Proficiency in crafting As-Is and To-Be system architectures, along with authentication and authorization flows.
  • Define strategies for scale-out and scale-up.
  • Define and conduct load and stress testing, and define physical architecture.
  • Develop logging strategies.
  • Awareness of popular design frameworks such as SOLID.
  • Familiarity with cloud architectural patterns.
  • Ability to estimate effort for large program and define resource loading
  • Advanced proficiency in Python with expertise in data science libraries (NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn) and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow)
  • Extensive experience with LLM frameworks (Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain) and prompt engineering techniques
  • Experience with big data processing using Spark for large-scale data analytics
  • Version control and experiment tracking using Git and MLflow
  • Software Engineering & Development: Advanced proficiency in Python, familiarity with Go or Rust, expertise in microservices, test-driven development, and concurrency processing.
  • DevOps & Infrastructure: Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), and container orchestration (Kubernetes) with Helm and service mesh implementations.
  • LLM Infrastructure & Deployment: Proficiency in LLM serving platforms such as vLLM and FastAPI, model quantization techniques, and vector database management.
  • MLOps & Deployment: Utilization of containerization strategies for ML workloads, experience with model serving tools like TorchServe or TF Serving, and automated model retraining.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Strong grasp of advanced cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure) and network security for ML systems.
  • LLM Project Experience: Expertise in developing chatbots, recommendation systems, translation services, and optimizing LLMs for performance and security.
  • General Skills: Python, SQL, knowledge of machine learning frameworks (Hugging Face, TensorFlow, PyTorch), and experience with cloud platforms like AWS or GCP.
  • Experience in creating LLD for the provided architecture.
  • Experience working in microservices based architecture.

Domain Expertise:

  • Strong mathematical foundation in statistics, probability, linear algebra, and optimization
  • Deep understanding of ML and LLM development lifecycle, including fine-tuning and evaluation
  • Expertise in feature engineering, embedding optimization, and dimensionality reduction
  • Advanced knowledge of A/B testing, experimental design, and statistical hypothesis testing
  • Experience with RAG systems, vector databases, and semantic search implementation
  • Proficiency in LLM optimization techniques including quantization and knowledge distillation
  • Understanding of MLOps practices for model deployment and monitoring

Professional Competencies:

  • Strong analytical thinking with ability to solve complex ML challenges
  • Excellent communication skills for presenting technical findings to diverse audiences
  • Experience translating business requirements into data science solutions
  • Project management skills for coordinating ML experiments and deployments
  • Strong collaboration abilities for working with cross-functional teams
  • Dedication to staying current with latest ML research and best practices
  • Ability to mentor and share knowledge with team members

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Data Science to lead the Forecasting team within the AI & Data Science organization. This role will be accountable for setting the data science strategy, developing and leading a high-performing team, and partnering product, program, operations, commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and other business stakeholders to deliver enterprise forecasting, uncertainty-aware decision support, scenario planning, and AI-enabled decision automation capabilities across Amgen.

The role is well suited to a leader who has built and managed data science or AI teams, delivered production-grade AI/ML solutions with measurable business impact, and can operate effectively in ambiguous, cross-functional environments. This leader will help Amgen advance AI-native forecasting and decision-support capabilities while supporting the company''s "every patient, every time" mandate.

Role Description:

The role is responsible for leading and charting the course for the Global Supply Chain Serialization Domain. SAP Serialization Solutions Lead will design, implement, and manage serialization solutions that ensure product integrity, regulatory compliance, and supply chain transparency. This role will be key contributor to Serialization Product Team serving as technical consultant as well as liaison between IT and business stakeholders, ensuring technical solutions align with compliance requirements, operational needs, and strategic objectives.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in SAP Advanced Track Trace for Pharmaceuticals (ATTP), Tracelink, SAP ICH (Information Collaboration Hub) or equivalent serialization systems, with strong technical background, business analysis and client-facing skills to translate requirements into scalable, reliable solutions.

  • Lead the design, configuration, and support of SAP ATTP (Serialization), SAP ICH, and related systems to meet global regulatory and business requirements.
  • Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications for serialization and supply chain traceability.
  • Oversee end-to-end implementation of serialization solutions, including integration with ERP, manufacturing, packaging, and partner systems.
  • Ensure compliance with DSCSA, EU FMD, and other regional/global serialization regulations.
  • Ensure adoption of AI driven tools and collaborating with business to identify AI driven use cases.
  • Collaborate with geographically dispersed teams, including those in the US and other international locations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, understanding needs, gathering requirements, and providing thought leadership.
  • Conduct workshops, stakeholder interviews, and requirements-gathering sessions to capture functional and compliance need to be maintained and prioritized in a Product Backlog.
  • Translate complex technical capabilities into business-friendly language, facilitating alignment across IT and business functions.
  • Partner with Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial teams to ensure serialization solutions drive measurable business value.
  • Maintain system documentation, business process workflows, and compliance reporting.
  • Ensure cross-team alignment and manage risks, escalations, and interdependencies.
  • Work with Operation Team to ensure proper Serialization system monitoring, identify improvement opportunities, and drive continuous optimization.
  • Lead vendor and partner relationships, ensuring quality delivery and alignment with business objectives.
  • Build and maintain relationships across IT, business units, and enterprise leadership to align strategy and execution.
  • Provide guidance, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing across IT and business analyst teams.

Basic Qualifications and Experience:

  • Masters degree with 8 - 10 years of experience in Business, Engineering, IT or related field OR
  • Bachelors degree with 10 - 14 years of experience in Business, Engineering, IT or related field OR
  • Diploma with 14 - 18 years of experience in Business, Engineering, IT or related field

Functional Skills:

Must-Have Skills:

  • Demonstrated experience with at least 5 years focused on SAP ATTP, ICH and serialization ecosystem.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP ERP (ECC/S4), SAP EWM, supply chain processes, and integrations with packaging as well as CMO and Logistics partners.
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical/life sciences regulatory requirements for serialization and track-and-trace (DSCSA, EU FMD, Brazil ANVISA, etc.).
  • Experience working in GxP or other regulated environments (e.g., pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare).
  • Proven track record as a business analyst or client-facing IT leader, bridging gaps between technology and business.
  • Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Good-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience in a leadership role within a pharmaceutical or technology organization
  • Extensive experience in software development lifecycle.
  • Strong analytic/critical-thinking and decision-making abilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Established business partnerships and IS governance practices involving senior business stakeholders
  • Broad working knowledge of key IS domains and layers

Professional Certifications (please mention if the certification is preferred or mandatory for the role):

  • SAFe Agile Practitioner (preferred)

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent leadership and team management skills.
  • Strong transformation and change management experience.
  • Exceptional collaboration and communication skills.
  • High degree of initiative and self-motivation.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully.
  • Team-oriented with a focus on achieving team goals.
  • Strong presentation and public speaking skills.
  • Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams

Shift Information:

This position requires you to work a later shift and may be assigned a second or third shift schedule. Candidates must be willing and able to work during evening or night shifts, as required based on business requirements.

Project Role : Solution Architect

Project Role Description : Translate client requirements into differentiated, deliverable solutions using in-depth knowledge of a technology, function, or platform. Collaborate with the Sales Pursuit and Delivery Teams to develop a winnable and deliverable solution that underpins the client value proposition and business case.

Must have skills : Amazon Web Services (AWS)

Good to have skills : AWS Architecture
Minimum 15 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:
We are seeking a seasoned Full Stack Enterprise Architect with deep expertise in designing and implementing application-heavy, multi-cloud enterprise solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in applications, infrastructure and integration, with hands-on experience in Java and/or .NET, and Python, as well as exposure to modern front-end technologies like React or Angular. A solid understanding of AI and its integration into enterprise systems is essential. This role will drive the architecture of scalable, secure, and innovative solutions to support business objectives across multiple cloud platforms.
As a Solution Architect, you will engage in a dynamic and collaborative environment where you will translate client requirements into innovative and effective solutions. Your typical day will involve working closely with various teams to ensure that the solutions developed are not only deliverable but also align with the client''s business objectives. You will leverage your extensive knowledge of technology and platforms to create value-driven proposals that meet client needs and expectations. Your role will also include continuous interaction with stakeholders to refine and enhance the solutions being offered, ensuring they are both practical and impactful.

Roles Responsibilities:
  • Solution Architecture: Design end-to-end, application-heavy enterprise architectures that integrate infrastructure, applications, data and platforms across multi-cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Application Development Leadership: Lead the design and implementation of robust, scalable applications with a focus on full-stack development, ensuring alignment with business goals.
  • Integration Strategy: Architect seamless integrations between systems, applications, and third-party services using APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
  • Multi-Cloud Strategy: Develop and implement strategies for deploying and managing applications across multiple cloud platforms, ensuring portability, scalability, and cost optimization.
  • Technology Leadership: Provide technical guidance on Java, .NET, and Python-based backend systems, and modern front-end frameworks like React or Angular.
  • AI Adoption: Incorporate GenAI/Agentic AI capabilities into enterprise applications, leveraging frameworks and tools to enhance productivity functionality (e.g., predictive analytics, automation).
  • Infrastructure Design: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design cloud-native solutions, including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Performance Security: Ensure solutions are optimized for performance, scalability, and security, adhering to industry standards and best practices.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, developers, DevOps, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Innovation Trends: Stay updated on emerging technologies, including AI advancements, cloud trends, and full-stack development practices, to drive continuous improvement.
  • Expected to be a Subject Matter Expert with deep knowledge and experience.
  • Should have influencing and advisory skills.
  • Responsible for team decisions.
  • Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
  • Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
  • Facilitate workshops and discussions to gather requirements and feedback from stakeholders.
  • Continuously assess and improve existing solutions to enhance client satisfaction.

    Professional Technical Skills:
  • 12 to 20+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, with at least 3 to 5 years in a full-stack architect role focusing on application-heavy solutions.
  • Proven track record of designing and deploying solutions in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Hands-on experience with Java and/or .NET, and Python for backend development.
  • Exposure to front-end technologies such as React, Angular, or similar frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of AI concepts and their application in enterprise systems.
  • Expertise in integration patterns (e.g., REST, GraphQL, Kafka, message queues) and microservices architecture.
  • Exposure to big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) and data integration pipelines.
  • Knowledge of enterprise integration platforms like MuleSoft, TIBCO, or Apache Camel.
  • Experience with infrastructure components such as containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless computing, and IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Understanding of DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and logging tools.
  • Knowledge of enterprise security practices, including IAM, encryption, and compliance standards.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong communication and leadership abilities to guide cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-friendly language.
  • Proactive, innovative mindset with a focus on delivering scalable solutions.

    Must To Have Skills:
  • Proficiency in Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Good To Have Skills: Experience with AWS Architecture.
  • Strong understanding of cloud computing principles and best practices.
  • Experience in designing scalable and secure cloud architectures.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools for continuous integration and deployment.

    Additional Information:
  • Education: bachelor s or master s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
    Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, TOGAF, or similar) are a plus.

Mentor junior and mid-level developers and share technical knowledge with the team.
Stay current with emerging AI-assisted software development practices and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through responsible use of AI tools.

Top 5 qualifications
  • Strong hands-on experience in Magento / Adobe Commerce frontend development.
  • Strong knowledge of Magento themes, layouts, templates, UI components, and frontend customization.
  • Strong experience with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, responsive web development, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Good understanding and hands-on experience with REST and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks, preferably React.js / Next.js, with exposure to Node.js / TypeScript.
AI Development Experience
Hands-on experience using Claude, preferably Claude Code , or similar AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or other agentic coding tools.
Experience using AI tools for software development activities such as code generation, debugging, refactoring, test creation, code explanation, documentation, and technical research.

Strong engineering judgment to review, test, debug, and validate AI-generated code before incorporating it into production applications.
Understanding of the limitations and risks of AI-generated code, particularly around security, authentication, authorization, data integrity, and destructive operations.

Experience with headless commerce architecture and modern storefront development.
Experience with GraphQL and API-driven commerce solutions.
Experience with Node.js / TypeScript and middleware or BFF development.
Exposure to Adobe Commerce API Mesh and App Builder.
Experience with commercetools, Mirakl, or other commerce/marketplace integrations is a plus.
Strong understanding of eCommerce concepts, workflows, integrations, and customer-facing digital experiences.
Experience working with Git and modern software development workflows.
Familiarity with automated testing and CI/CD practices.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, Agile development environment.
Willingness to adopt new technologies, AI-assisted development practices, and modern engineering tools.

A career with thought leaders who literally wrote the book on Marketplace Best Practices.
A career in the fast-paced world of retail eCommerce, digital marketplaces, and platform businesses.
A career with first movers who are deploying new business models and strategies worldwide.

Salesforce Professional Services is building a Global Solutions CoE to create a more consistent, scalable, and predictable way to shape, scope, estimate, and deliver Professional Services (ProServe) programs.
We are looking for a Practice Domain Overlay Manager to make sure the CoE model is not generic. This role brings the required product, industry, regulatory, and domain depth into scoping and estimation so that our standards work in real customer situations.
This role does not own every product or every industry. Instead, it owns the process of identifying where specialized input is needed, capturing that input into reusable patterns, and ensuring the CoE model reflects real delivery complexity.
The right candidate understands how Salesforce programs vary by cloud, industry, geography, regulatory environment, and customer maturity - and can turn those differences into practical scoping and estimation guidance the field can actually use.
What You Will Do
1. Identify Where Domain Expertise Is Required
You will define when a deal needs additional practice or domain input during scoping.
Examples:
  • Data Cloud program with complex source systems and identity resolution
  • Agentforce program with unclear automation boundaries or trust requirements
  • Health / Life Sciences program with regulatory or data privacy considerations
  • Public Sector program with procurement, compliance, or security constraints
  • Financial Services program with sensitive data, controls, or integration complexity
  • Multi-cloud program involving Sales, Service, Data, Marketing, Commerce, MuleSoft, or Industry Clouds
Your job is to make these triggers explicit so the field knows when to pull in the right expertise.
2. Build Product and Industry Overlay Patterns
You will create practical overlays that sit on top of the core CoE model.
Each overlay should answer:
  • What is different for this product, industry, or domain
  • What additional discovery questions are required
  • What scoping assumptions should be added
  • What roles or skills are typically needed
  • What risks should be flagged early
  • What SOW language or exclusions are required
  • What delivery dependencies must be confirmed before signature
Examples of overlays:
  • Data Cloud readiness overlay
  • Agentforce scoping overlay
  • Regulated industry overlay
  • Public Sector delivery overlay
  • Integration complexity overlay
  • Migration / data readiness overlay
  • Multi-cloud transformation overlay
  • Change and adoption overlay
3. Translate Practice Knowledge Into Reusable Assets
You will work with Practices and domain SMEs to convert expertise into usable CoE assets.
Expected outputs:
  • Discovery questions
  • Scoping checklists
  • Estimation factors
  • Role and skill assumptions
  • Risk indicators
  • SOW assumptions and exclusions
  • Delivery readiness checkpoints
  • Reference examples from past programs
This role is not about creating long documents. The goal is to create short, reusable assets that can be embedded into scoping workflows, tools, agents, and playbooks.
4. Maintain the Domain Pattern Library
You will own the structure and quality of the domain pattern library.
The library should include:
  • Product-specific scoping guidance
  • Industry-specific considerations
  • Regulatory and compliance triggers
  • Common risks and mitigation patterns
  • Standard assumptions and exclusions
  • Recommended SMEs / practices to engage
  • Reusable examples from successful programs
You will ensure assets are current, easy to find, and practical enough for field use.
5. Support Better Estimation Accuracy
You will help improve estimates by identifying domain-specific effort drivers.
Examples:
  • Number and quality of data sources
  • Number of integrations
  • Number of clouds involved
  • Customer operating model maturity
  • Regulatory review requirements
  • Testing and validation intensity
  • Migration complexity
  • Localization / regional requirements
  • AI governance and trust requirements
  • Change management and adoption effort
Your role is to make sure these drivers are not missed during estimation.
6. Improve Scoping Quality for Complex Programs
You will help prevent common scoping misses.
Examples:
  • Data migration underestimated
  • Integration effort treated as standard
  • Security / compliance review missed
  • Testing effort too light
  • Customer dependencies not documented
  • Change management excluded when adoption risk is high
  • Product capability assumptions not validated
  • Agentforce use cases scoped without clear human-in-the-loop design
  • Fixed-fee risk accepted without enough clarity
Your job is to make these risks visible before the deal is signed.
7. Partner Across the Ecosystem
This role is highly cross-functional and must work closely with peer organizations.

GDC
Validate whether domain patterns are executable at scale and reflect offshore / distributed delivery realities.

Align domain overlays with governance checkpoints, delivery controls, and quality expectations.

Ensure domain overlays align to priority offerings, market plays, and repeatable solution motions.

Validate staffing, resource, and operational assumptions tied to each overlay.

Ensure field-facing guidance supports faster qualification, cleaner discovery, and better deal progression.

Capture what is working in live deals and feed lessons back into the pattern library.

  • Scoping and SOW assumptions are clearer and more complete
  • Practice knowledge becomes reusable instead of tribal
  • CoE tools and agents use domain logic, not generic prompts
  • Programs are better shaped before they move into delivery
  • The domain pattern library becomes a trusted source for the field
